title: Auto-resize is not working
author: comsami
body_snippet:
I am using Windows RDP in windowed mode. When I resize the remote desktop window, the screen content does not scale automatically. Even though I have enabled 'Smart sizing' (Automatic Resize), it's still not working.

version : mRemoteNG-20260222-v1.78.2-NB-3405-x64-SC
